vocabulary.example: Speaking is instantaneous; people hear your mistakes right away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one more (an + other); used with singular nouns
vocabulary.example: Can I have another cup of tea?

vocabulary.meaning_en: different; often used with plural nouns
vocabulary.example: I need other people to help me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to create something; when you finish, you have something
to perform an action or activity
vocabulary.example: I do my homework every evening.
He works hard to make money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to wash the plates and cups
vocabulary.example: I'll do the dishes after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: exactly the same in size, number or amount
vocabulary.example: Cut the cake into two equal parts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: giving each person what they deserve or need; right
vocabulary.example: It's not fair: we did the same work, but he got more money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have earned something because of what you did
vocabulary.example: You worked hard; you deserve a rest.
We had fun at the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to return to the place where the speaker is (here)

vocabulary.example: Next month I will go back to my country.

fine_lines.title: another vs other
fine_lines.explanation_ar: another = an + other = واحد إضافي، ويأتي مع المفرد. other = مختلف، ويأتي غالبًا مع الجمع (other people) أو مع the (the other coat).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Another = an + other = one more; use it with singular nouns. Other = different; usually with plurals (other people) or with the (the other coat).

examples.sentence: I need another person to help me.
We need other people to help. / Not this jacket, the other one.

fine_lines.title: make vs do
fine_lines.explanation_ar: make = تصنع شيئًا فيصبح لديك شيء في النهاية (make a cake, make dinner, make money). do = نشاط أو عمل (do homework, do the dishes). do أيضًا فعل مساعد للتوكيد: I do love it.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Make = create something; at the end you have something (make a cake, make dinner, make money). Do = an activity or action (do homework, do the dishes). Do is also an auxiliary for emphasis: I do love it.

examples.sentence: I made dinner for my family.

fine_lines.title: equal vs fair
fine_lines.explanation_ar: equal = نفس الكمية تمامًا. fair = ما يستحقه أو يحتاجه كل شخص. الشيء العادل قد لا يكون متساويًا: الشخص الكبير يحتاج قطعة أكبر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Equal = exactly the same amount. Fair = what each person deserves or needs. Fair is not always equal: a big person needs a bigger piece.

examples.sentence: Each team has five players. The teams are equal.
We both made five things, so it's fair that we both get $50.

fine_lines.title: fun vs funny
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fun = ممتع، تستمتع به (تبتسم). funny = مضحك، يجعلك تضحك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Fun = enjoyable; you enjoy it (you smile). Funny = it makes you laugh.

examples.sentence: The trip was fun. I enjoyed it.
His story was so funny that we laughed a lot.

fine_lines.title: come back vs go back
fine_lines.explanation_ar: come back = العودة إلى المكان الذي يوجد فيه المتكلم الآن (هنا). go back = العودة إلى مكان آخر (هناك). الطالب في كندا يقول: When I go back home, I'll speak good English.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Come back = return to where the speaker is now (here). Go back = return to another place (there). A student in Canada says: "When I go back home, I'll speak good English."

examples.sentence: I'm going to Cairo, but I'll come back here next week.
When I go back to my country, I'll visit my parents.

expressions.example: He got two pieces and I got none. That's not fair!
Thanks for the visit. I had fun.
It was nice to see you. Come back soon!
These cookies are good. Can I have another one?

grammar.title: another + singular; other + plural
grammar.explanation_ar: another (= an + other) مع الاسم المفرد المعدود: another book. other مع الجمع: other books. ومع the للشيء الآخر المحدد: the other book.
grammar.explanation_en: Another (= an + other) goes with a singular countable noun: another book. Other goes with plurals: other books. Use the other for the specific different one: the other book.
examples: This pen doesn't work. Give me the other one.

grammar.title: Collocations with make and do
grammar.explanation_ar: مع make (نصنع شيئًا): a cake, dinner, money, a mistake, a decision. ومع do (نشاط): homework, the dishes, work, exercise, your best.
grammar.explanation_en: Make: a cake, dinner, money, a mistake, a decision. Do: homework, the dishes, work, exercise, your best.

grammar.title: Come and go depend on where you are
grammar.explanation_ar: come = حركة نحو مكان المتكلم. go = حركة بعيدًا عنه. إذا كنت هنا الآن فقل come back here و go back there.
grammar.explanation_en: Come = movement toward the speaker's place. Go = movement away from it. If you are here now, say come back here and go back there.
examples: When I go back to Japan, I'll miss you. I hope I can come back here one day.

questions.explanation_en: One more with a singular noun: another.
